verdict.rationale: The GitHub README confirms pre-request scripts, i.e. code that runs before a request is sent (gh-5). The AI-features docs mention scripting for pre-request logic and test cases (docs-23, docs-35), which implies post-response test scripts. However, nothing in the pack shows scripts extracting response data into variables to chain requests, or transforming payloads. missing for 10: documented post-response scripting API, evidence of chaining requests via scripted variable setting, data-massaging examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
